title: Use the host workdir for pinned source_id capture processes
outcome: Pinned source capture follows the existing host process working-directory policy while --root remains the sole measured-root input and trusted pins, bounds and full-object semantics stay intact.
acceptance: The capture process uses an explicitly host-owned workdir according to existing launch policy; it does not retain the measured tree as cwd. Any required interface change is agreed with the source_id owner and native callers before implementation.

Focused boundary coverage proves the measured root remains the --root argument, host cwd is separate, and existing executable byte-pin checks, caller deadline and full returned identity are preserved on supported platforms.
